title: Nonconforming part containment
text: Nonconforming parts must be identified and separated from accepted product. Record the part number, lot reference and observed deviation in the quality log. Notify the quality lead. Only the quality team can approve disposition or release. This fictional training example does not replace a site procedure.

title: Calibration record lookup
text: Locate the gauge identifier in the approved calibration register. The record shows calibration status, due date and responsible metrology owner. If the record is missing or overdue, notify the quality lead and follow the local approved procedure. This assistant cannot approve gauge use.

title: Shift handover documentation
text: Shift handover notes include open quality issues, material shortages and unresolved maintenance requests. Record each issue owner and next action. The outgoing supervisor reviews the handover draft before it is shared with the incoming team.

title: Quality deviation investigation
text: Quality deviation investigations record the affected lot, evidence, root cause hypothesis and corrective action owner. Separate observed facts from hypotheses. The quality manager reviews the investigation before closure. Financial impact is not included in this document.

title: Engineering change approval
text: Engineering change requests require a documented impact assessment, validation plan and accountable approver. Engineering owns the technical review. No engineering change is authorized by an assistant response. Record validation evidence before requesting release.

title: Document revision and ownership
text: The document controller maintains one current approved document revision. Superseded revisions are archived. Each document has an owner, revision number and review date. Report conflicting document versions to the document controller.
